newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia private consumption growth to slow in '96.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia private consumption growth to slow in '96.

text.p: Malaysia's private sector comsumption is set to grow by 10.6 percent in 1996 against 13.1 percent growth in 1995, the Finance Ministry said on Friday.
The ministry's annual Economic Report said a slower rate of growth in disposable incomes due to credit control measures imposed in 1995 was the reason.
The measures included tighter credit terms for financing purchases of cars and real estate, the report said.
As a result "sales of passenger cars decelerated substantially to 12.3 percent after recording a strong growth of 59.2 percent in the same period of 1995", it said.
